Case: normal use - a teammate opens a story whose merged part has no review history on this laptop and whose story and other parts have no known reviews.
When `gaps` is true and the known total is zero, this branch displays `unknown` rather than `at least 0`. The owner's repair ruling requires an `at least N` total whenever a merged part's history is absent. The new missing-history test always supplies four known reviews, so it does not exercise this case.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a part has two worker turns without reviews, then its published history grows past the 20,000-byte limit and those turns are folded together.
The new filter accepts any entry without a `reviewed` flag. Current-version summaries can lose that flag too: `src/forge/time_records.py:638-639` folds summary entries using `_fold`, whose return at lines 52-53 omits `reviewed`. Two unreviewed turns can therefore become an unflagged range that the story counts as two reviews. This is new evidence beyond the ruling that an unflagged summary from an older release counts as reviewed.

why: A story whose parts have merged says "No review rounds yet" and shows an unknown review round count, even though its review rounds sit on its parts.
